verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਕੋ ਮਹਾਤਮ ਅਗਾਧ ਬੋਧ ਅਤਿ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਮੈ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਨਮ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: charan kamal ko mahaatam agaadh bodh at asacharaj mai namo namo nam hai ||

en.bdb: The praise of the lotus feet of Satguru Ii is comprehension. It is indeed wonderful. Salutations time and again.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੋਮਲ ਕੋਮਲਤਾ ਔ ਸੀਤਲ ਸੀਤਲਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਸੁਭਾਸ ਤਾਸ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਨ ਸਮ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: komal komalataa aau seetal seetalataa kai baasanaa subhaas taas dhuteeaa na sam hai ||

en.bdb: They are tender than the tenderness of the whole world. They are indeed comfortably cool. No other fragrance matches them.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਨਿਜ ਆਸਨ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਰਸ ਗੰਮਯਤਾ ਅਗਮ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sahaj samaadh nij aasan si(n)ghaasan savaiaadh bisamaadh ras ga(n)mayataa agam hai ||

en.bdb: The disciple, who lives ever in attendance of the holy feet of the True Satguru Ii and has worked hard on meditation of Lord's name, has relished the supernatural elixir of Naam Simran.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰੂਪ ਕੈ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਮਨ ਮਨਸਾ ਥਕਤ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਬਿਸਮੈ ਬਿਸਮ ਹੈ ॥੮੦॥
verses.translit_en: roop kai anoop roop man manasaa thakat akath kathaa binodh bisamai bisam hai ||80||

en.bdb: The beauty of Satguru's lotus feet is exemplary. The desire and faculty of mind tires describing it. Their praise indescribable. This wonder of wonders is astonishing. (80)
